title: Energy transfer quiz with answer key
subject: Science
unit: Spring 2: Reactivity (9F); energy transfer by heating
source: Seeded from science/y9 lesson 43 (Energy transfer quiz with answer key (portal))
intro: Covers lessons 26 to 43 of Reactivity (9F); energy transfer by heating. Answer every question. For multiple choice, fill in one circle.

questions.q: A balloon bursts when over-filled. This is...
questions.a: B) A physical explosion. No new substance is made: gas pressure bursts the rubber.

questions.q: A sealed bottle of air is put in the fridge. The pressure inside...
questions.a: B) Decreases. Colder particles move more slowly and hit the walls less: lower pressure.

questions.q: Mass in an open fizzing cup decreases because...
questions.a: B) Gas escapes into the air. The atoms are still there, in the gas that left.

questions.q: Which metal would NOT react with dilute acid?
questions.a: C) Copper. Copper is below hydrogen in the series.

questions.q: Which jar shows that air is needed?
questions.a: B) C. Jar C has water but no air; compare with A.

questions.q: Which metal could protect iron sacrificially?
questions.a: B) Magnesium. Magnesium is more reactive than iron, so it corrodes first.

questions.q: Temperature falls from 22 °C to 17 °C. The reaction is...
questions.a: B) Endothermic. A fall in temperature means energy was taken in from the surroundings.

questions.q: The steel wool warmed by 5 °C. The reaction is...
questions.a: B) Exothermic. Temperature rose, so energy was given out.

questions.q: Breaking bonds needs 500 kJ; making bonds gives out 700 kJ. The reaction is...
questions.a: A) Exothermic. More energy given out (700) than taken in (500): overall 200 kJ given out.

questions.q: Will copper displace zinc from zinc sulfate?
questions.a: B) No. Copper is less reactive than zinc, so no reaction.

questions.q: How is zinc extracted?
questions.a: B) Heating with carbon. Zinc is below carbon, so carbon can reduce its oxide.

questions.q: Which is a physical explosion?
questions.a: B) Over-inflated tyre. No new substance is made in a bursting tyre.

questions.q: Why do pans have plastic handles?
questions.a: B) Plastic is an insulator. An insulating handle transfers energy slowly so it stays cool.

questions.q: How does the Sun's energy reach Earth?
questions.a: C) Radiation. Space has no particles, so only radiation can cross it.

questions.q: Which wrap was the best insulator in the example?
questions.a: C) Towel. It lost least temperature: 70 to 58 °C, a drop of 12 °C.

questions.q: A motor takes 500 J and gives 300 J of useful kinetic energy. Wasted energy?
questions.a: A) 200 J. Wasted = 500 - 300 = 200 J (conservation of energy).

questions.q: A Sankey shows 500 J in and 150 J useful. Efficiency?
Which surface is best for a solar water heater panel?
questions.a: B) Matt black. Matt black absorbs infrared best.

questions.q: Group 1 metals with water make a hydroxide and...
questions.a: Hydrogen

questions.q: Is rusting a physical or chemical change?
questions.a: Chemical
